_README: Where the player stands with each of the ten organisations.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
never overwrites it. The organisations themselves come from the workbook
(boosters.json); this file only says how standing with them works.
EVERY NUMBER IS A PLACEHOLDER awaiting Cameron.
Pleasing an organisation at a press conference - answering a question in
the suit it invites - raises your standing with the group behind that
question by 'per_please'. Standing starts at 'start' for all ten and is
LIVES FOR THIS SITTING ONLY. Like the meta-variables in sanban.json, it
is lost when the game is closed until milestone M4 builds saving.
WHAT STANDING DOES. Cameron's decision: an organisation will not sell you
its backing until you have given it reason to. 'required_standing' is the
standing you need with the organisation behind a modifier before it can
be bought at all - the press conference's long-term payoff.
Override it for a single modifier under 'required_standing_by_modifier',
so a National organisation can ask more than a local one without any of
it becoming a special case in code. PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS.
